extracted.intended_audience: law firms, patent attorneys and practitioners using GlobalIPCo to file German Gebrauchsmuster (utility model) applications
extracted.subtask_description: Practical, step-by-step filing and document requirements for obtaining German utility models (Gebrauchsmuster) via the GlobalIPCo online system, including PCT national phase and direct/convention routes, timing, document format, claim rules, fees and renewals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights and term
rubrics_metrics.description: A German Utility Model provides the same rights as a German patent for 10 years from the date of filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing paths and time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Two paths: (A) national phase entry of a PCT patent application within 31 months from earliest priority date (or PCT filing date if no priority); (B) direct/convention filing claiming priority from one or more patent applications or utility models filed within the previous 12 months (no extension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For PCT national phase: German translations of PCT specification and any Art.19/34 amendments are required at filing and cannot be filed after the 31-month limit. If filed before PCT publication, Forms PCT/RO/101 and PCT/RO/105 must be submitted on filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document language and completeness on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: The German Utility Model specification (description, claims, figures) must be filed in German and all required documents (including pdf copy of each priority application for convention filings) must be submitted together on filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For national phase PCT entries, if priority documents were provided to WIPO no priority documents need be filed with GlobalIPCo; if convention filing, upload either the as-filed application (preferably with filing receipt page 1) or a certified copy. DPMA does not accept published copies of priority documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal examination only (no substantive examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: The German Patent and Trademark Office conducts only formal examination and the Utility Model is immediately granted/registered after successful formal examination; there is no substantive examination by DPMA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite lack of substantive examination, enforceability depends on novelty and inventiveness; Prisma IP's cursory review does not guarantee avoidance of DPMA office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty and prior art rules for enforceability
rubrics_metrics.description: Although not substantively examined, to be enforceable the Utility Model must be novel and inventive. Prior art includes prior written disclosure anywhere in the world and prior use within Germany; prior use outside Germany is not detrimental. Applicant disclosures within 6 months before the time rank are excluded from prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority and partial priority principle
rubrics_metrics.description: A German Utility Model may claim priority from one or more patent applications or utility models filed during the previous 12 months; the content of the German specification need not be strictly identical and partial priority applies — priority valid only for content disclosed in the priority application; added content has filing-date time rank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required uploads for PCT national phase
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload three separate pdf files for German translations of the description, claims and drawings of the original PCT specification; ensure number of claims in the German translation is identical to the number in the original PCT specification and all drawings are included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If filing before PCT publication, also upload Forms PCT/RO/101 and PCT/RO/105. If those forms or original PCT spec are unavailable, filing may proceed but DPMA processing and application number issuance will be delayed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required uploads for direct / convention filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload German description (pdf), German claims (pdf), and German figures (if any) (pdf). For each priority claimed, upload a pdf copy of the priority document (certified copy, scan of certified copy, or uncertified copy as filed). No translation of priority documents required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not required: German abstract, inventor data, signed power of attorney, or translations of priority documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: General formatting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Description, claims and figures must be in German; margins: upper 2.5 cm, left 2.5 cm, right 1.5 cm, bottom 1.0 cm; do not use line numbers; do not use paragraph numbers in the description; use only SI units; do not refer to brand names/trademarks; typed text only (no handwritten text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings formatting rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings must be black & white or grayscale (no colour), use reference numbers referred to in description and claims, drawing numbers and reference numbers must be at least 0.32 cm high (as high as text), no handwritten text, and no text apart from figure and reference numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims: allowed and disallowed subject-matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Multi-dependent claims and multiple independent claims are allowed (unity of invention required but relatively lenient). Method claims and plant/animal variety claims are not allowed in German Utility Models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the PCT patent includes such disallowed claims, amended German claims deleting method or plant/animal variety claims must be filed. There is no limit on number of claims and costs do not depend on number of claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims: use of reference numbers and renumbering on deletion
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference numbers are permitted in claims. If a claim is deleted all subsequent claims must be renumbered and antecedent references adjusted accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments on filing and new matter prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: For national phase PCT entries amended documents may be submitted on filing (e.g., to remove method claims, correct errors, delete figures) by uploading clean sheets; for convention filings amended German version may be uploaded in clean form relative to priority. It is not allowed to add new matter not disclosed in the original PCT (e.g., new figures), but corrections to figures (e.g., reference numbers) are allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not upload tracked change versions. New claims may be added only if supported by the original PCT description/claims (fair basis). Amended documents must be complete (upload all pages even if only one sentence changed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional requirement for national phase amended filings
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to the amended German document in clean form, you must upload a German translation of the original (unamended) PCT patent specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of applicants (adding/removing/recording assignments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants can be changed from the applicants of the priority or PCT application by entering all (new and old) applicant names and addresses on filing. Convention applicants may be changed to add applicants at no cost or to remove applicants for USD 80. For national phase, recording a change of applicant on filing costs USD 80.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No signed documents or deeds of assignment need be uploaded, though proof of assignment should be kept by the applicant. DPMA may automatically reorder applicants (often alphabetically); the registration certificate shows only applicant's name, city and country; applicant's address must be a residential address (not a work address).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering and entering applicant details when they differ
rubrics_metrics.description: If German Utility Model applicants differ from PCT/priority applicants, follow the system prompts to indicate 'Are the German Utility Model applicant(s) the same as the PCT/priority applicant(s)? = NO' and then enter all intended applicants for the German utility model as they should appear on the certificate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided show entering priority applicants separately from German applicants; adding an applicant does not incur cost, deleting an applicant costs USD 80.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay of grant and publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant and publication of national phase German Utility Models cannot be delayed. For convention/direct German Utility Models a request to delay grant and publication by up to 15 months is possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To delay, indicate the number of months for the delay on the GlobalIPCo system. An additional USD 50 is automatically applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listings
rubrics_metrics.description: The GlobalIPCo system does not provide for lodging of sequence listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review on filing by Prisma IP
rubrics_metrics.description: Prisma IP conducts a cursory review of all German Utility Models prior to filing and may, without notice, make non-substantial changes required to comply with DPMA rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite this review, GlobalIPCo/Prisma IP do not guarantee that no office action will be issued by DPMA for applications filed using the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office actions and response cost
rubrics_metrics.description: If DPMA issues an office action for formal defects, you will be notified and requested to submit substitute documents. The fixed cost to respond to an office action via GlobalIPCo is USD 200.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing and fixed-cost model
rubrics_metrics.description: GlobalIPCo charges fixed fees irrespective of number of priority claims, claims, pages, etc. Example fees: Filing to grant USD 390 (inclusive of Euro 30/40 official fees), Delay of publication/grant USD 50, Postage USD 110 per parcel (up to 6 certificates), Response to office action USD 200.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other fee items and PayAnnuity renewal fees are detailed in tariff table; change of applicant on filing USD 80; renewals and PayAnnuity surcharges listed separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renewal timings and fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Renewals must be paid on the 3rd, 6th and 8th anniversaries (counted from the earlier of the PCT filing date / German Utility Model filing date) to maintain the Utility Model for a 10-year term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official renewal fees shown (examples): 3rd year Euro 210 (Total PayAnnuity fee USD 344), 6th year Euro 350 (USD 511), 8th year Euro 530 (USD 726). Additional USD 25 charged if renewal not processed online. Renewals may be paid during a 6-month grace period on payment of a penalty.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to file — required steps and form data (national phase)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure: (1) Register on GlobalIPCo.com; (2) Receive discount code for law firms and add to profile; (3) Complete the national phase German Utility Model application form, providing required German translations and PCT metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required form inputs: German translations of original PCT claims, description and figures; German translation of Article 19/34 pages if any; title in German; PCT application number and filing date; applicant's name and physical address; number of claims and figures of original PCT spec; earliest priority date. Not required: German abstract, inventor data, signed POA, copies/translations of priority documents (if PCT priority docs already provided to WIPO). Application title must be in German.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to file — required steps and form data (direct/convention)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for direct/convention filings: (1) Register; (2) add discount code; (3) complete direct/convention application form providing German application documents, applicant details, priority number/date/country and copy of priority document if priority is claimed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not required: German translation of abstract, inventor data, signed POA, or translations of priority documents. Format of priority number allows spaces and must include dot before last digit (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Uploading amendments and partial amendment rules
rubrics_metrics.description: If answering 'Will you make an additional amendment on filing?' upload amended documents in the specified upload slots. Amendments must be in clean form (no tracked changes) and complete (all description pages even if only a small change). If amending claims only, upload only 'Amended claims for on-filing amendment'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If PCT includes method claims you must file a German claim set without method claims as 'Amended claims for on-filing amendment'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority number formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted formats for priority numbers allow spaces (example given: CN 10 2023 123 456.7 or 102023123456.7). Do not omit the dot before the last digit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postage arranging and grouping certificates
rubrics_metrics.description: You may request courier postage of the paper registration certificate via the system; you can group up to 6 German Utility Model certificates per parcel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: System uses 'mass' to determine number of certificates per parcel; enter courier address; postage example fee USD 110 per parcel (up to 6 certificates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tariff of fees: itemised charges and notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Tariff table lists itemised charges (e.g., filing, delay, postage, response to office action, renewals, cession/changes, change of applicant name) and official fee components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many fees given in both Euro (official fee component) and USD (total fee via GlobalIPCo). Some items show Euro 0 official fee but a GlobalIPCo handling fee (e.g., assignment recording). Detailed tariff provided in manual.
